gloss: to be finished, to be settled

definitions.gloss: to be finished, to be done
to be settled, to be resolved
definitions.explanation: For a matter to be concluded.

examples.japanese: {謝|あやま}って{済|す}む{問題|もんだい}ではない。
examples.english: This isn't something that can be resolved with an apology.

examples.japanese: {用事|ようじ}が{済|す}んだら{連絡|れんらく}します。
examples.english: I'll contact you when I'm done with my errands.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}で{済|す}む{話|はなし}だ。
examples.english: It's something that can be settled with a phone call.

notes:
{済|す}む is an intransitive godan verb meaning 'to be finished' or 'to be settled.'

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {済|す}ませる (transitive, to finish/complete)

KEY PATTERNS:
- Xが{済|す}む: X is finished
- V-て{済|す}む: can get by with doing V
- V-ないで{済|す}む: can manage without doing V
- それで{済|す}む: that will be enough/sufficient

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {仕事|しごと}が{済|す}んだ: the work is done
- {用事|ようじ}が{済|す}む: business is finished
- {食事|しょくじ}が{済|す}む: finished eating
- {謝|あやま}って{済|す}む{問題|もんだい}ではない: not something an apology can fix

NOTE:
Don't confuse with {住|す}む (to live, to reside), which has the same reading but different kanji and meaning.
